generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy an existing parent key value from the parent's reserved non-orphan pool; allow NULL only if column is nullable; each instance must include at least one NULL (if nullable) and at least one parent row with no child rows. The reserved unreferenced parent key must be chosen from parent keys that are NOT referenced by any compact child row and NOT referenced by any generated child row; reserve one such key per FK relationship and exclude it from the FK draw pool.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer within the column's range rule; guarantee each listed boundary literal and one step on each side appears at least once per instance (deterministic injection, not probabilistic). Values drawn from the boundary literal pool are injected verbatim and are never perturbed by arithmetic steps; only free uniform draws may be perturbed.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform real within the column's range rule, rounded to 2 decimals; guarantee each listed boundary literal and one step on each side appears at least once per instance (deterministic injection). Boundary literals are injected verbatim and never perturbed.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Pick from a small pool of distinct values; allow near-duplicates (case/whitespace variants) and NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Pick uniformly from the enumerated value list; NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Format 'Month D' (e.g. 'December 2'); generate dates from an expanding fresh generator that yields N distinct date strings for N rows (fresh_value_share of the pool is newly minted per instance, not drawn from a fixed 21-element pool); NULL if nullable. Composite PK (Exhibition_ID, Date) uniqueness is enforced per Exhibition_ID group: after FK assignment, for each Exhibition_ID group the Date values must be distinct; dedupe (Exhibition_ID, Date) tuples and regenerate colliding dates until the full tuple set is unique.

targets.note: Negative literals are unreachable because Ticket_Price >= 0; only non-negative boundary literals are sampled.

targets.per_group_avg: Computed over the FULL merged instance (compact + generated rows). For at least one Exhibition_ID group the group average Attendance must be < 200, and for at least one (possibly different) group the average must be > 200; across instances the exact value 200 must also occur as a group average. The generator must choose Exhibition_IDs for the low/high/exact groups that are not contaminated by compact rows (i.e. groups composed only of generated rows, or groups whose compact rows are adjusted/absent), and must verify the target on the merged data after composite-PK dedup and before writing. Execution feedback must report per-group AVG straddling 200 (both sides 199/201 and exact 200).

dependencies.rule: UNIQUE(Exhibition_ID, Date) enforced per Exhibition_ID group after FK assignment; dedupe tuples and regenerate colliding dates; assert zero rows skipped by the writer for exhibition_record.

uncertainty: No calculated columns or date-order pairs exist. Nullable columns have 0% NULL in the sample but are declared nullable, so NULLs are generated per the NULL rule: at least one NULL per nullable column per instance, with share floor 0.15 (not a tracked compact share). Ticket_Price negative boundary literals (-5.01, -5, -4.99) are unreachable under Ticket_Price >= 0 and are excluded from sampling. Composite PK (Exhibition_ID, Date) uniqueness is enforced per Exhibition_ID group after FK assignment; the writer must report zero skipped rows for exhibition_record and the generator must assert on the actual (Exhibition_ID, Date) tuple set before writing. Boundary literals are injected verbatim and never perturbed by arithmetic steps; only free uniform draws may be perturbed. Per-group AVG(Attendance) straddling 200 is computed over the full merged instance (compact + generated rows) and must be verified by execution feedback; groups used for the low/high/exact targets must not be contaminated by compact rows. Parent-rows-without-children is enforced deterministically by reserving one parent key per FK relationship that is not referenced by any compact or generated child row, and excluding it from the child FK draw pool; a post-write check must confirm at least one parent row has no child rows for each FK relationship. After fixing the composite-PK skip, re-verify that Attendance NULL share meets the 0.15 floor on the written rows.
